MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful next step because I would try a larger display for home controls and viewing compatible security cameras alongside my existing entertainment setup.",
    "The Alexa smart plug fits because controlling a lamp would add a practical new use to my connected home."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV sticks repeat a function already covered by my 4K stick and Fire TV television, so their similarity to past purchases gives me little reason to choose them now.",
    "The headphones and earbuds do not address my current interest in home entertainment equipment and security cameras, and I have shown no particular need for iPhone accessories.",
    "The smaller display and voice-only Echo devices fit my interests, but I would choose the Show 8 this time because its larger screen better serves the viewing use I have in mind."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV equipment seems to have been taken as a reason to offer more streaming sticks, without considering whether they add anything to what I already have.",
    "My interest in connected-home devices seems to have been stretched into interest in several similar Alexa devices and unrelated personal audio products."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters to me now is adding a useful capability, such as a larger home-control display or control of a lamp, rather than repeating an existing function.",
    "My camera purchases make viewing compatible security cameras a more compelling reason to choose a display than simply having another device with Alexa."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my connected-home interests but missed how strongly my choices depend on adding a useful capability to the equipment I already own."
}
